care: Regular Vacuuming: 1. Vacuum your rug regularly (at least weekly) to remove grit and dry soil. Use suction only, and avoid rotating brushes, as these can damage the rug. 2. Vacuum in the direction of the pile, and be careful near fringes. Spot Cleaning Spills: 1. Blot spills immediately with a clean, dry cloth. 2. Do not rub, as this can damage the fibers. 3. For stubborn stains, consider using a mild soap solution with warm water, but test in an inconspicuous area first. Deep Cleaning: 1. For a deep clean, contact a specialist rug cleaner. Other Tips: 1. Use a rug pad to help protect your rug from moving and color transfer. 2. If your rug is made of natural fibers, shedding is to be expected. 3. Always follow the specific care instructions provided with your rug.
name: Hand Tufted Cut Pile Micro Fiber Rug
